portableEquivalent.scope: Equivalent original assertions on isolated ports; original330X not requested

typeChecks.runner: Direct existing local binaries; pnpm workspace runner attempted interactive modules reset and was not used

independentReview.scope: Independent source review of approved upload journey and audit visual changes; review did not modify application/tests/configuration or user UAT data.

closedFindings.issue: Cross-format image batch adopted first successful file before remaining files failed, losing the current old-preview association in the unsaved edit
closedFindings.resolution: Separate staged READY and adopted files; apply only after all pending/failed resolved; explicit apply after deleting failures; remove all staged preserves old preview/source/version

closedFindings.issue: Queued files while staged could mix preview types or bypass cumulative 200-page validation
closedFindings.resolution: choose rejects all new queue additions until staged is applied or deleted, before any queue mutation or upload reservation

closedFindings.issue: Selecting a new file retained the prior completed 100-percent progress bar
Table-cell min-height did not yield planned actual row height
closedFindings.resolution: Use height:50px; isolated headless browser measured actual one-line row height50px

closedFindings.issue: Operations success banner retained old strong border and 6px radius
closedFindings.resolution: Audit-scoped 8px radius and border0; independently measured in headless DOM

retainedBoundaries: Selection does not upload; explicit click creates task and transmits File bytes
READY/history/classification/version gates protect completion; completion only emits to parent editor
Delete only removes current selection/reference, without physical delete API or history mutation
Original File references are transmitted serially; no Base64 or whole-file string copy introduced
Modal scroll-body is opt-in; default modal slot structure, busy close guard and focus restoration remain
Audit scripts, role gates, fields, filters, cursors, date semantics and no-export boundary preserved
